# vastdata_de_metrics (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# NOTE: All metrics in a comma-separated `metric_names` query must share the same
# `metric_type` (e.g., all Counter or all Histogram). Mixing types returns HTTP 422.
# Use `data.vastdata_de_metric_names` to discover available metric names and their types.
data "vastdata_de_metrics" "example" {
  tenant_name  = "de-lab"
  metric_names = "dataengine.function.invocations,dataengine.event.total"
  pipeline     = "my-pipeline"
  aggregation  = "avg"
  timeframe    = "1h"
  max_points   = 60
}

output "metrics_query" {
  value = data.vastdata_de_metrics.example.query
}

output "metrics_results" {
  value = data.vastdata_de_metrics.example.results
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `metric_names` (String) Comma-separated list of metric names (1-10 metrics, e.g. "http_requests,memory_usage,dataengine.function.invocations"). Allows alphanumeric characters, dots, colons, and underscores.

### Optional

- `aggregation` (String) Aggregation method (defaults to 'avg')
- `bottom_k` (Number) Return only the bottom K groups with lowest values (requires group_by, mutually exclusive with top_k)
- `function` (String) Function name filter (optional)
- `function_deployment` (String) Function deployment name filter (optional)
- `group_by` (String) Group metrics by dimension (function_name or pipeline_name)
- `max_points` (Number) Maximum data points to return
- `metric_type` (String) Filter by metric type (optional)
- `pipeline` (String) Pipeline name filter (optional)
- `tenant_name` (String) Tenant name for Data Engine API queries. Required for cluster-admin auth; optional when the provider already authenticates as that tenant.
- `time_end` (String) End time for query
- `time_start` (String) Start time for query
- `timeframe` (String) Time window like '30s', '5m', '1h', '7d'. Defaults to '1h' if neither timeframe nor time_start/time_end are specified.
- `top_k` (Number) Return only the top K groups with highest values (requires group_by, mutually exclusive with bottom_k)

### Read-Only

- `query` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--query))
- `results` (Attributes Set) Per-metric results array (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

Read-Only:

- `aggregation` (String) Aggregation method used
- `bucket_size_seconds` (Number) Size of time buckets in seconds

- `metric_names` (Set of String) Metrics that were queried
- `time_range` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--query--time_range))

- `group_by` (String) Dimension to group metrics by (function_name, pipeline_name, or function_deployment_name)
- `metric_type` (String) Metric type filter applied
- `pipeline` (String) Pipeline filter applied
- `top_k` (Number) Top K groups filter applied (highest values)

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `groups` (Attributes Set) Array of grouped metric data. Contains one or more groups depending on query grouping. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--groups))
- `groups_found` (Set of String) List of unique group values found (only present when group_by is used)
- `metric_description` (String) Human-readable description of the metric
- `metric_name` (String) Name of the metric
- `metric_type` (String) Type of metric (Counter, Gauge, etc.)
- `metric_unit` (String) Unit of the metric (ms, bytes, percent, etc.)
- `scope` (String) OpenTelemetry scope name (e.g., "vast-runtime" for automatic metrics, "user" for custom metrics)
